Surpanakha whole + wounded sheets specified; Ravana king + ascetic
Fact / tradition sheet with supported/disputed/simplified/dramatized verdicts
10 episode packets (story goal + framework goal + gate); no images yet

a3.title: Sketch-conditioned enhance
a3.exit_gate: ≥2 methods × ≥3 panels from ONE Capture scene (not all 10 episodes); ink/print style lock signed; no restage; ledger + report
checklist: Pick one prove scene (ep 1 approach, ep 8 capture, or ep 10 Jatayu)
Bake-off ≥2 methods on ≥3 panels from that single scene
Style lock is ink/print — not korean_manhwa
High sketch control; restaging is a fail
Default method: line-art two-stage; human ink on hero pages
Ledger + living-report numbers if images/evals ran
notes: Commit when done: phase-v2a-a3: lock sketch-conditioned enhance and ink style
A3 is NOT a 10-episode render. Three panels from one scene.
Image APIs: GOOGLE_API_KEY and fal direct. No OmniRoute images.

a4.title: Panel memory + human gate
a4.exit_gate: Panel N+1 uses approved N: approve/ink/reject + Version 2 taxonomy; last-N refs passed in; 3-panel face/light hold
checklist: Human gate: approve, light ink, or reject with a Version 2 taxonomy code
Pass last-N approved frames into the next enhance
3-panel sequence holds face and lighting
Knowledge is bible + last-N frames, not live weight updates
notes: Commit when done: phase-v2a-a4: panel memory constrains the next enhance
Reuse Version 2 taxonomy codes (identity_drift, continuity, prompt_art_miss, …) — do not fork v2_program.json

a5.title: Distill loop
a5.exit_gate: ≥30 approved pairs; style/lead LoRA or critic beats baseline; no live PPO; no per-panel fine-tune
checklist: Accumulate ≥30 approved (sketch, refs, shot card) → panel pairs
Train style LoRA and/or one LoRA per lead — or a critic that beats baseline
Weights update on a schedule (end of episode / end of arc), not live
No live PPO on pixels; no per-panel foundation-model fine-tune
notes: Commit when done: phase-v2a-a5: distill from approved storyboard pairs

test_series.title: Aranya — The Capture
test_series.product_claim: FRAMEWORK TEST — not 'the product is only Ramayana'. Same slots must later fit Mahabharata, history, romance, original.
tone_rules: Desire and violence are explicit and readable

episodes.title: Surpanakha sees Rama
episodes.story_goal: Panchavati; she is struck by Rama; proposes; he refuses and points her to Lakshmana.
episodes.framework_goal: Desire + two-person blocking + forest light lock. Cast: Rama, Surpanakha, Sita glimpsed.
episodes.gate: Bible looks hold; shot cards make her approach readable without restaging.

episodes.title: The insult
episodes.story_goal: Lakshmana rejects her; the mutilation (nose/ears) is consequence, not spectacle; she flees cursing.
episodes.framework_goal: Adult violence without gore-porn; her face before vs after.
episodes.gate: Two Surpanakha sheets (whole / wounded); you signed the violence line.

episodes.title: Khara's war
episodes.story_goal: She brings Khara–Dushana; Rama fights; the rakshasa force falls.
episodes.framework_goal: Crowd/war (3D blockout is a later backup); Rama identity in action.
episodes.gate: Battlefield location lock + crowd rule; Rama still matches ep 1.

episodes.title: Report to Lanka
episodes.story_goal: Surpanakha before Ravana; she describes Sita; his pride turns to wanting her.
episodes.framework_goal: New location (Lanka court) + new lead (Ravana) + wounded-Surpanakha continuity.
episodes.gate: Ravana bible + Lanka lock signed; her wound still present.

episodes.title: Maricha's counsel
episodes.story_goal: Ravana recruits Maricha; golden-deer plan; Maricha's fear.
episodes.framework_goal: Two-hander intrigue; Ravana consistency from ep 4.
episodes.gate: Maricha bible; plan fact-checked as dramatized Valmiki beat.

episodes.title: Golden deer
episodes.story_goal: Sita wants the deer; Rama hunts; Maricha's dying cry in Rama's voice.
episodes.framework_goal: Magic/creature + off-screen voice; Sita + ashram lock from ep 1.
episodes.gate: Deer design locked; ashram matches ep 1; cry labeled dramatized.

episodes.title: Empty hut / rekha dramatized
episodes.story_goal: Sita sends Lakshmana; threshold / rekha (mark dramatized vs tradition); Ravana as ascetic.
episodes.framework_goal: Three-person exit + disguise (Ravana readable to us, not to Sita).
episodes.gate: Disguise sheet + never lose Ravana identity to the reader.

episodes.title: The capture
episodes.story_goal: Ravana seizes Sita; Pushpaka; she resists.
episodes.framework_goal: Abduction staging (adult, not exploitation); sky/chariot; Sita continuity.
episodes.gate: You signed the capture boards; Sita face matches ep 1/6.

episodes.title: Jatayu's stand
episodes.story_goal: Jatayu fights Ravana; wings cut; Sita drops jewels.
episodes.framework_goal: Aerial fight + new lead + jewel prop trail.
episodes.gate: Jatayu bible; jewels are a continuity prop, not a one-off.

episodes.title: Jatayu tells Rama
episodes.story_goal: Empty ashram; dying Jatayu; Rama learns who took Sita; vow.
episodes.framework_goal: Grief + testimony + callback to ep 1 location and ep 9 wounds.
episodes.gate: Ashram + Jatayu wounded sheet match; series recap one-pager exists.

a3_bakeoff.scope: 3 panels from ONE scene, not all 10 episodes
